records.proposal: plumb withdraws a card by itself, at the moment its question stops standing, instead of leaving you to ask for a clean-up: a stale-link card once its link is no longer stale, a read-back or trial card once every record it asks about is confirmed or superseded, and any card a confirmed record of yours already answers, as a model judges it; you are told in one line what was withdrawn and why

At each turn end, and right after plumb repin, relink or unlink, plumb withdraws a stale-link card whose link is current or no longer exists, and a read-back or trial card whose records are all confirmed or superseded; each withdrawal is logged and named in one line of the end-of-turn text

A background job, using the session's judge on its cheap model, reads each open card against the owner's confirmed records and withdraws a card only when a confirmed record answers it (quoting that record) or when it duplicates another open card; unsure keeps the card; it never answers a card and never counts a proposed record
